responsibility: This file implements the out-of-line behavior of `lazy_diagnostic_path`, a diagnostics utility that defers expensive path construction until a diagnostic is actually emitted and queries the path. It forwards the `diagnostic_path` virtual interface to an inner path created on first use, and under checking builds it provides selftests that verify the path is not generated for skipped warnings but is generated for emitted diagnostics and behaves like a normal path thereafter. Its responsibility is lazy materialization of event/thread path data for GCC diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: Implements the out-of-line forwarding methods and lazy materialization behavior for `lazy_diagnostic_path`, and also contains checking-build selftests for deferred path creation. In this same-name pair, the .h only declares the abstract wrapper and its `make_inner_path` hook.
